reviews.title: Good product, was missing a piece.
reviews.comment: What was in the box was the right thing, but was the wrong box. This was fine, but was slightly confusing. I saw the sticker on it indicating it was the right part. The unit is supposed to come with adapters for AM4/AM5 socket, but did not. I had to order that separately. Overall, it works great.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer
